items.title: The Safety Reckoning Inside OpenAI
items.summary: OpenAI’s rogue agent hack was a watershed moment for AI safety and cybersecurity. It also sparked internal questions about the culture that led to it.
items.author: Maxwell Zeff

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI Manifesto Is 6,500 Words—and Barely Says Anything
items.summary: AI is shifting the culture, from tech CEO manifestos to 1 am job interviews. We unpack some of the latest, along with the top findings from Black Hat and Defcon, this week on Uncanny Valley.
items.author: Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, Leah Feiger, Andy Greenberg

items.title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
items.summary: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.
items.author: David Cox
